*First shared on [LinkedIn on 14 May 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/iangow_taxonomy-of-researchers-activity-7460781812202651649-i_jG), with the slide deck below.*

I did a presentation to prospective "Honours" students at the University of Melbourne in 2019.
I think my taxonomy of researchers holds up, especially now that we have literal robots doing research.

A taxonomy of researchers:

- Visionaries
- Scientists
- Research Robots
- Glass Bead Game Players
- Pragmatists
